results.answer: Microsoft's diluted earnings per share for fiscal year 2026 were $17.95. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data)
Nasdaq's basic earnings per share in 2025 was $3.12 (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Earnings Per Share).
Microsoft's total liabilities as of June 30, 2026 were $315,989 million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > BALANCE SHEETS)
Nasdaq's operating income in 2025 was $2,331 million (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Consolidated Statements of Income).
Oracle's income before income taxes in fiscal 2026 was $19,554 million (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules > Segment Information).
Microsoft's cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, 2026 were $20,935 million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > CASH FLOWS STATEMENTS)
Nasdaq's cash and cash equivalents were $604 million as of December 31, 2025 (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of).

Oracle declared cash dividends of $2.00 per share of common stock in fiscal 2026. (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)
Nasdaq paid a total of $601 million in cash dividends in 2025 (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity).

Microsoft paid $6,759 million in common stock dividends in fiscal 2026, as stated in the excerpt from MSFT-10K-2026.html, section PART II > Item 5. MARKET FOR REGISTRANT’S COMMON EQUITY, RELATED STOCKHOLDER MATTERS, AND ISSUER PURCHASES OF EQUITY SECURITIES (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 5. MARKET FOR REGISTRANT’S COMMON EQUITY, RELATED STOCKHOLDER MATTERS, AND ISSUER PURCHASES OF EQUITY SECURITIES).

Oracle paid $63 million in dividends to its holders of Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock and $5.7 billion in dividends to its common stockholders in fiscal 2026 (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations).
The excerpts don't contain information about cash dividends per share declared by Netflix in 2025.

Microsoft spent $115,948 million on additions to property and equipment in fiscal 2026 (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > CASH FLOWS STATEMENTS).

Oracle spent $55.7 billion on capital expenditures in fiscal 2026. (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)
Microsoft spent $16,719 million in fiscal 2026 repurchasing its common stock. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > Stockholders' Equity)

Nasdaq spent $616 million in total purchase price for repurchasing its common stock in 2025, excluding $4 million of accrued excise tax that had not been paid as of December 31, 2025 (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity).

The excerpts don't contain the total long-term debt at December 31, 2025. However, they do state that as of December 31, 2025, the Company had aggregate outstanding notes of $14,463 million, net of $56 million of issuance costs and discounts (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Debt).
Netflix's cost of revenues in 2025 was $23,275,329 thousand (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements).
Netflix's total current liabilities at December 31, 2025, were $10,980,930 thousand (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements).
Netflix's sales and marketing expenses in 2025 were $3,301,306 thousand. (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements)

Oracle's combined net income for fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 was $17,087 million for 2026 and $12,443 million for 2025 (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules).
Nasdaq's operating income increased by $533 million from 2024 to 2025 (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of).

Microsoft's total current assets as of June 30, 2026, were $207,710 million, and its total current liabilities as of June 30, 2026, were $168,825 million. Therefore, Microsoft's current ratio as of June 30, 2026, was $207,710 million / $168,825 million, which equals 1.23. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA)

The total net income for 2023, 2024, and 2025 is $10,981,201 + $8,711,631 + $5,407,990 = $25,100,822 thousand. (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Segment and Geographic Information and PART IV > Financial Statements > Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income)

The total amount paid of $601 million was recorded in retained earnings in the Consolidated Balance Sheets at December 31, 2025, as cash dividends, and the total purchase price of $616 million was recorded in the Consolidated Balance Sheets at December 31, 2025, as share repurchases. (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity and PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity)

Microsoft's net income increased by $31.9 billion from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026, from $101,832 million to $133,749 million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data)

The excerpts don't contain Oracle's net income as a percentage of its total revenues in fiscal 2026.
